source: ComicsBox USA series indexes, ComicsBox issue protagonist credits, and existing MarvelTracker paths
rules: Dedicated series are followed issue by issue using the first verified Italian publication.
Team/co-billed sources marked protagonistOnly are filtered story by story using ComicsBox protagonist credits.
Shared history is reused only when the character is credited among the protagonists of a USA story already represented by MarvelTracker.
Simple appearances and cameos are excluded unless an exact historically important issue is explicitly selected in configuration.
A physical Italian issue keeps its global ownership identity; reading progress remains path-local through readingStep.contentIds.
Ultimate, MAX, What If and explicit alternate/cross-company continuities are excluded from the Earth-616-focused character paths.
Missing Italian first publications remain explicit audit gaps and are never replaced with invented editions.

paths.name: Elektra
paths.subtitle: Elektra Natchios · Assassina della Mano
paths.description: Percorso principale di Elektra Natchios dalle storie con Daredevil alle serie soliste, alla Mano e alle incarnazioni moderne; Ultimate e crossover intercompany sono esclusi.

paths.name: Deadpool
paths.subtitle: Wade Wilson · Mercenario Chiacchierone
paths.description: Percorso Earth-616 di Wade Wilson dalle prime miniserie alle serie regolari, Cable & Deadpool e i principali team-up canonici; MAX, Kills the Marvel Universe, Pulp, What If e altre realtà alternative sono esclusi.

paths.name: Cable
paths.subtitle: Nathan Summers · Soldato del futuro
paths.description: Percorso Terra-616 di Nathan Summers dalle origini con i Nuovi Mutanti e X-Force alle serie Cable, Cable & Deadpool e alle incarnazioni moderne.

paths.name: Magik
paths.subtitle: Illyana Rasputin · Regina del Limbo
paths.description: Percorso ibrido mutante/mistico di Illyana Rasputin: Magik, Nuovi Mutanti, Limbo, X-Men e storie magiche soliste, con selezione protagonista-only delle testate di squadra.
